claims.evidence: Witness report says the control panel text looks like “YAMAHA” and a model number ending with “PSR-…”, and the seller states it is PSR-175.
Witness report does not show a power-on/functional test (no audio/keys/LCD/screen test shown).
Witness report does not provide clear condition/wear details (scratches, cracks, speaker grille wear) from the photos.

risks.risk: Not actually working (dead keys, faulty buttons/knobs, no sound, LCD not functioning, or intermittent power).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, LCD boot, playing several keys across the range, and changing sounds/volume with audible output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully verified/possible faults (worst-case: needs repair or has partial functionality).

risks.risk: Missing or faulty power adapter (keyboard may not run without the correct adapter).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the exact included adapter label/specs and a power-on demonstration using it.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming adapter may be missing or not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (scratches, cracked casing, loose/missing keys, damaged speaker grilles).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both speaker grilles, keybed area, and corners/edges showing any cracks or missing/loose keys.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case cosmetic wear/possible minor damage.

risks.risk: LCD issues (dead pixels, dim display, flicker) that may not be obvious without a clear screen test.
risks.proof: Video showing the LCD at different brightness/menus for several seconds, plus a still close-up of the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if LCD may be imperfect.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (sustain pedal, stand, manuals, original box) affecting usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (pedal/stand/cables/manuals) and a quick test of the sustain pedal if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming accessories may be incomplete.

proof_requests: Power-on video: LCD turns on, then play keys across low/middle/high range with audible sound.
Show volume control and at least one sound/voice change working.
Close-up photos of speaker grilles, key tops, and any visible wear/cracks.
Photo of the power adapter (label/specs) and confirm it powers the keyboard in the video.
If a sustain pedal is included, show it and demonstrate it works.
response.reason: The witness report identifies the item as a Yamaha PSR-series keyboard with full-size keys and a control panel consistent with PSR-175, so it can be priced at worst-case condition. Functional claims are not proven by the photos, so the price should assume possible faults until tested.
